study type: Case series with root cause analysis
exposure: delayed entry into perinatal and HIV care
maternal adherence challenges in the setting of substance use and other adverse social determinants of health
failure to diagnose maternal HIV infection in a timely way
cohort: The study cohort consists of 6 cases of perinatal HIV diagnoses recorded in Maryland in 2022.
finding: Maryland recorded an increase to 6 cases of perinatal HIV diagnoses in 2022, after zero transmissions in 2021, with multiple factors contributing including delayed care entry, premature birth, maternal adherence issues, and delayed maternal HIV diagnosis.
